intro.text: King Dedelin's second child, raised to inherit the throne of Idris because his elder sister was promised to Hallandren's God King.

items.text: As children, Ridger and his youngest sister Siri were often in trouble together, until he grew older and gave most of his time to his studies and to being prepared to rule.

personality.text: Kind-hearted and always trying to do the right thing, he got on well with his youngest sister, Siri.
